(the “Company”) completed the separation (the “Separation”) of its ADI Global Distribution business into an independent, publicly traded company, ADI Global Distribution Inc. (NYSE: ADIG). This Current Report on Form 8-K is being furnished in connection with the Company’s announcement of its financial results for the third quarter ended October 3, 2026. In addition to the Company’s third quarter 2026 financial results, the press release furnished as Exhibit 99 includes supplemental unaudited historical financial information for certain prior quarterly periods reflecting the ADI Global Distribution business as discontinued operations and presenting the Company’s continuing operations following the Separation, as well as reconciliations of certain non-GAAP and standalone supplemental financial measures. Item 2.02. Results of Operations and Financial Condition. On November 10, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing its financial results for the third quarter ended October 3, 2026 and providing an update to its outlook for the fourth quarter and full year 2026. A copy of the press release, including the supplemental financial information furnished therewith, is attached hereto as Exhibit 99 and is incorporated herein by reference. The information furnished pursuant to this Item 2.02, including Exhibit 99, is being furnished and shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that Section. Such information shall not be deemed incorporated by reference into any filing of the Company under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
